question: Q4 alternatives: reorder the circuit to need fewer registers
number: Greedy list scheduling (free-most-operands-first) on the DAG gives the same peak, 25; at R=12 it is slightly better (68 vs 69 extra ops/batch), at R=8 worse (134 vs 112). The state of the 3 rounds is 16 words plus the 8 message words that are re-used by the permutation, which makes 24 a floor for this circuit shape; fewer needs a different dataflow (for example processing the four columns of a round in two halves with message words reloaded, which is what the spill rows measure). No alternative below 25 without loads was found.
